name: Azure
description: Your Azure subscriptions: resources, costs, AKS clusters, logs and alerts, plus scaling a node pool and restarting an app when you approve.

capabilities.why: Reads and manages Azure resources as you, with your Azure CLI sign-in.
Runs log queries in your Log Analytics workspaces.
Instead of your az sign-in: a service principal (client id as the username, secret as the password).

subscriptions.description: Subscriptions to look in, by name or id. Empty: every one the sign-in sees.

auth.description: How to sign in. Default: the az helper if granted, else the service principal.

tenant.description: Directory (tenant) id, for the service principal.

workspace.description: Default Log Analytics workspace (name or workspace id) for logs.

tools.name: subscriptions
tools.description: Azure subscriptions this sign-in can see, and which are in scope for the other Azure tools.

tools.name: resources
tools.description: Find Azure resources across subscriptions (Azure Resource Graph). Filter by type, resource group, name, tag or location, or pass a Resource Graph KQL query for anything else (counts, properties, joins).

type.description: Resource type, full (microsoft.web/sites) or a fragment (sites, storage)

tag.description: key=value, or key to find anything with that tag

subscription.description: One subscription, by name or id (default: all in scope)

query.description: A Resource Graph query instead of the filters, e.g. resources | summarize count() by type

top.description: At most this many rows (default 50, up to 1000)

tools.name: costs
tools.description: Azure spend per subscription, this month so far (or last month), grouped by service, resource group, resource, location or meter.

tools.name: clusters
tools.description: AKS clusters in scope: Kubernetes version, power and provisioning state, and each node pool's size, VM size, autoscale range and state.

tools.name: logs
tools.description: Run a KQL query in a Log Analytics workspace (container logs, app requests, exceptions, KubeEvents…). Read-only.

query.description: KQL, e.g. ContainerLogV2 | where LogLevel == 'error' | take 50

workspace.description: Workspace name or id (default: the plugin's setting)

tools.name: alerts
tools.description: Azure Monitor alerts firing now, newest first: severity, target resource and since when.

tools.name: scale_node_pool
tools.description: Set an AKS node pool's node count (not for autoscaled pools). The owner approves every call.

tools.name: restart_app
tools.description: Restart an App Service web app or function app. The owner approves every call.
